title: S3 Spine — Prompt Catalog
description: Canonical prompt catalog for the S3 Spine subsystem, providing structured MCP prompts for graph traversal, operator execution, dimensional amplification, and example interpretation.

prompts.description: Describe the S3 Spine structural graph including nodes, edges, semantics, and causal direction.
Traverse the S3 Spine graph from a given start node following canonical sequencing rules.
Apply a spine operator (push, pull, bind, gradient, fieldShift, ruptureForce) to a node and describe the resulting semantic changes.
Validate an operator sequence against canonical sequencing rules.
Apply dimensional amplification to a spine semantic using the 11-dimension subsystem.
Explain how a specific dimension (L4, L5, L8, L10, L11, L12, L16, L26, L32, LH, LI) interacts with operators and semantics.
Load a spine example envelope (canonical, reality, imagination, information, error, qmroot).
Describe the purpose and interpretation layer of a spine example envelope.
Explain the operational protocol for interacting with the S3 Spine subsystem.
Describe the spine registry and its relationships across structural, operator, dimensional, and example assets.
Explain the schemas used by the S3 Spine subsystem including example, module, operator, dimensional, lineage, and session schemas.
Describe the S3 Spine module manifest including structural files, documentation, examples, and Docsbook metadata.
